filter.description: Field to operator/value objects. All predicates are combined with AND. Only registered scalar fields are filterable.

select.description: Top-level field projection. Omitted means all public fields.

orderBy.description: Scalar sort keys; default is source order. Equal keys retain source order.

include.description: Declared relation names mapped to query options (filter, select, orderBy, limit, include). Maximum two relation levels.

limit.description: Root page size. Defaults to 50. At most 200 rows including relations.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same query over live data; it is not a transaction snapshot.

danmaku.align_keep.capability: inspect alignment without changing the binding

danmaku.offset.capability: set any supported absolute offset in milliseconds

danmaku.set_dedup.capability: set displayFold while preserving raw caches

danmaku.set_enabled.capability: set enabled absolutely with binding revision

snapshotId.description: Null: observations do not form a global transaction snapshot.

sources.description: View name to UTC ISO-8601 read time; cached data can be older.

rows.description: Public projections described by each registered view. Relations contain rows, truncated and nextQuery.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for the same live query; null when no root continuation is known.

truncated.description: True when pagination or a resource limit omitted data.

warnings.description: Resource limits: time_limit, scan_limit, row_limit, byte_limit, field_limit, relation_limit, sort_within_scan_window.
